headline_marked: [[Referee body admits 'error']] for Haaland's winning goal in Manchester derby
headline: Referee body admits 'error' for Haaland's winning goal in Manchester derby
summary: Pro Ref acknowledged an "error of judgment" in allowing Erling Haaland's goal, despite a Manchester City player being in an offside position and potentially impacting play. The decision sparked significant controversy.
details: Professional Game Referees (Pro Ref) admitted an "error of judgment" regarding the decision to allow Erling Haaland's winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 victory over Manchester United. The controversial goal occurred after Phil Foden's dismissal, with Haaland scoring from close range.

The goal was initially disallowed for offside against Haaland but VAR overturned it. This was despite City midfielder Enzo Fernandez being in an offside position and attempting to reach the ball before Haaland.

VAR initially determined Haaland was onside and that Fernandez, while offside, did not touch the ball. However, Pro Ref later stated VAR "did not recognise the likely impact" of Fernandez's position and "should have recommended an on-field review."
Pro Ref has contacted Manchester United to acknowledge the error, stating a review of the incident will take place. United manager Michael Carrick expressed concern over the officials' decision.

United defender Lisandro Martinez claimed he was clearly impacted by Fernandez's presence, which allowed Haaland to be free. Martinez called the goal an "injustice," deeming such mistakes by multiple officials "unacceptable."

headline_marked: [[Zverev wins US Open title]], defeating Shelton for second Grand Slam trophy
headline: Zverev wins US Open title, defeating Shelton for second Grand Slam trophy
summary: Alexander Zverev defeated Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (7/2), 5-7, 6-2 to win the US Open. This victory marks his second Grand Slam title, overcoming his 2020 Flushing Meadows defeat.
details: Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (7/2), 5-7, 6-2 to win the US Open on Sunday. This victory marks his second Grand Slam title, expunging the memory of a bitter Flushing Meadows defeat in 2020.

The top-seeded German had previously been within two points of the US Open crown in 2020 but lost in five agonizing sets to Dominic Thiem. This year's US Open trophy adds to the French Open title he captured earlier.

Zverev denied Shelton's attempt to become the first US man in 23 years to lift a Grand Slam trophy. Shelton was just shy of his first birthday when Andy Roddick achieved the last major triumph for a US man in 2003.

Hopes were high for Shelton after his epic five-set quarter-final victory over defending champion Carlos Alcaraz and a comeback win against Frances Tiafoe in the semi-finals. However, Zverev's all-court excellence proved too much for the American.

Despite strong crowd support, Shelton only managed to surge in the third set, reducing errors Zverev had exploited. He secured his first break of the match in the third set, pushing the match to a fourth.

Zverev immediately responded, breaking Shelton's serve in the opening game of the fourth set after a 24-shot rally. He maintained his lead, shaking off a time violation warning to secure the game and eventually the match.
